name: Kurdistan Region

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and green, with a golden sun of 21 rays in the center.
flag.symbolism: The sun is an ancient symbol in Kurdish culture, and its 21 rays are usually linked to 21 March, Newroz, the Kurdish new year; red is commonly said to stand for sacrifice, white for peace and green for the land.

hook: Kurdistan is red-white-green with a blazing 21-rayed gold sun; Tajikistan has a crown under stars, and Iran puts green on top.
trivia: A similar flag was used by the short-lived Republic of Ararat around 1927, and the Kurdistan Region adopted it in 1992.
Kurds in neighbouring countries also fly it as a symbol of Kurdish identity, but it has official status only in Iraq's Kurdistan Region.
